steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each KPI's band is matched to its target. A band that does not follow from the target is a gap.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 KPI band does not follow its target

findings.title: Band does not follow from the target
findings.fix: Recompute the band from the target

findings.title: KPI reported with no source
findings.fix: Name the source of the figure

outcome.notChecked: Whether the KPI measures what matters.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] kpi-cost.csv:12  Band does not follow from the target.
       Fix: Recompute the band from the target.
[medium] kpi-accuracy.csv:19  KPI reported with no source.
       Fix: Name the source of the figure.
[low] kpi-satisfaction.csv:26  KPI with no definition.

pros: Checks a KPI with no definition, a value whose band does not follow from the target, and a KPI reported with no source.
cons: Not checked: Whether the KPI measures what matters.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ops-kpi-scorecard skill on the records for this review.
